name: Cable Management Tray
description: An open steel basket that clamps under the desk and carries the power strip, the adapters and the slack that would otherwise hang down the back of it. The clamp fits tops from 1.5 to 5 cm and needs no drilling. Because the sides are open wire rather than a closed box, air moves through it and you can pull one cable out without unthreading the rest. Tie straps are included for bundling, and the steel is powder-coated against rust.

Recline, tilt lock and seat height sit under the seat, on a Class 3 gas lift and a heavy-duty five-star nylon base.
